ui.chat.composer_notes.default_not_saved.note: The reason is either the backend's own error text (untranslated, arrives verbatim) or the fallback sentence in default_not_saved_fallback.

placeholders.reason: why the save failed: the backend's message verbatim, or the localized fallback phrase

ui.chat.composer_notes.default_not_saved.role: composer note shown when saving the default model for new sessions failed
ui.chat.composer_notes.default_not_saved.tone: short factual sentence then the reason, no trailing period

ui.chat.composer_notes.default_not_saved.note: Reads as the end of the sentence 'The default was not saved: ...'. Keep it a fragment.
ui.chat.composer_notes.default_not_saved.role: fallback reason spliced into the 'default was not saved' note when the failure carried no message

ui.chat.composer_notes.default_saved.note: The value is a provider/model identifier and is shown verbatim.

placeholders.model: provider and model id joined by a slash (for example anthropic/claude-opus); a technical identifier, never translated

ui.chat.composer_notes.default_saved.role: composer note confirming the saved default model for new sessions after a slash command
ui.chat.composer_notes.default_saved.tone: short factual label then value, no trailing period

ui.chat.composer_notes.goal.done_tag.note: Sits to the right of the goal text and is the first thing the row gives up when narrow, so keep it as short as the English. Keep the leading dash.
ui.chat.composer_notes.goal.done_tag.role: small tag after a finished goal's struck-through text in the composer status row
ui.chat.composer_notes.goal.done_tag.tone: very short lowercase tag led by an em dash

ui.chat.composer_notes.goal.stalled.brea.note: Names the cause (the judge, not the provider) and the next move (send a message). The English mirrors the backend's own wording for the same event.
ui.chat.composer_notes.goal.stalled.brea.role: one-shot note written into the transcript when a goal stops because the judge could not read a verdict
ui.chat.composer_notes.goal.stalled.brea.tone: plain lowercase status clause with an em-dash instruction, no trailing period

ui.chat.composer_notes.goal.stalled.cap.note: The count is the backend's continuation budget and renders as #. The English mirrors the backend's own wording.

placeholders.count: how many automatic continuations ran before the stop; drives the plural branch and renders as #

ui.chat.composer_notes.goal.stalled.cap.role: one-shot note written into the transcript when a goal stopped after using its automatic continuations
ui.chat.composer_notes.goal.stalled.cap.tone: plain lowercase status clause with an em-dash instruction, no trailing period

ui.chat.composer_notes.goal.stalled.cap_.note: Same event as goal.stalled.cap without a number. The English mirrors the backend's own wording.
ui.chat.composer_notes.goal.stalled.cap_.role: one-shot note written into the transcript when a goal hit its automatic-continuation limit and the count is unreadable
ui.chat.composer_notes.goal.stalled.cap_.tone: plain lowercase status clause with an em-dash instruction, no trailing period

ui.chat.composer_notes.goal.stalled.unkn.note: Deliberately names no bound; it says only that automatic continuation stopped. The English mirrors the backend's fallback wording.
ui.chat.composer_notes.goal.stalled.unkn.role: one-shot note written into the transcript when a goal stopped for a cause this build cannot name
ui.chat.composer_notes.goal.stalled.unkn.tone: plain lowercase status clause with an em-dash instruction, no trailing period

ui.chat.composer_notes.hint.choose_model.note: Shown in place of the send affordance's explanation; the model picker sits just above.

ui.chat.composer_notes.hint.connect_prov.tone: short instruction, sentence case, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.composer_notes.outside_mentions.role: screen-reader-only description of the composer box when @-mentioned files sit outside the working directory
ui.chat.composer_notes.outside_mentions.tone: one full sentence, sentence case, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.composer_notes.skill_load_failed.tone: plain lowercase status clause, no trailing period; names what happens next
